name: @mesh/power-interface
description: Standard power service contract, independent of its providers.

available.description: Whether the power service is reachable and a battery is present

charging.description: Whether the battery is currently charging

time_remaining_minutes.description: Estimated minutes of remaining runtime on battery (0 if unknown/charging)

time_to_full_minutes.description: Estimated minutes until full charge while charging (0 if unknown/discharging)

power_draw_watts.description: Instantaneous power draw or charge rate in watts

health_percent.description: Battery health as a percentage of design capacity (0.0-100.0, 0 if unknown)
